description: Fuzzy string matching for JavaScript and TypeScript, and a drop-in replacement for string-similarity: similarity scores, did-you-mean, search-as-you-type, highlight, dedupe, join lists, quiz answer checking, Levenshtein, Dice, Jaro-Winkler. Zero dependencies.
rules: Scores go from 0 to 100, not 0 to 1: write similarity(a, b) >= 80 or isMatch(a, b), never > 0.8. The threshold option is 0-100 too.
closest() returns a Match ({ item, score, index, text }) or undefined: use closest(query, list)?.item to get the value.
Items that are objects need the keys option: search(query, users, { keys: ['name', 'email'] }).
Options are always an object in the last argument.
To search the same list on every keystroke, build createIndex(items, options) once and call index.search(query).
To replace string-similarity without changing code, import from 'fuzzy-toolkit/string-similarity' (compareTwoStrings and findBestMatch, 0-1 ratings, same results).
